actions.script: const L = (text) => text.length > 255 ? text : ec.l10n.localize(text) found = false notFoundText = null testRan = false testError = null const detail = emailAccountId ? ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.get#MailAccountDetail').parameter('emailAccountId', emailAccountId).call() : null if (ec.message.hasError() || !detail?.found) { notFoundText = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.getErrorsString() : L('Which account?'); ec.message.clearErrors(); return } found = true account = detail.account canManage = account.canManage === true server = detail.server provider = detail.provider folderRows = Array.from(detail.folderList || []) memberRows = Array.from(detail.memberList || []) showSetupDone = setup === 'done' deliveredHere = account.deliveredHere === true deliveredHereText = account.hasServer ? L('The mail gateway delivers mail for this address. There is no incoming mailbox to sync; the outgoing server sends mail.') : L('The mail gateway delivers mail for this address. There is no mail server and no password.') setupDoneSyncText = account.problemText || (!account.hasIncomingServer ? L('The account is ready. Open the Inbox to read its mail.') : account.lastSyncText ? L('Your mail is ready in the Inbox. New mail appears as the account syncs.') : L('The first sync is under way: your mail shows in the Inbox as it arrives, the newest first. A large mailbox takes a while; you can use the Inbox meanwhile.')) // how it signs in: a password, or a provider's sign-in (get#OAuthStatus), and whether this server offers that sign-in const signInState = detail.signIn || {} isOAuth = signInState.isOAuth === true oauthChoice = detail.oauth || null oauthConfigured = oauthChoice?.configured === true providerLabel = oauthChoice?.providerLabel || null needsSignIn = canManage && account.hasServer && (account.statusId === 'EasAuthFailed' || fix === 'Y' || signInState.needsSignIn === true) oauthSignInText = isOAuth ? (signInState.signedIn ? ec.resource.expand('Signs in with ${name} as ${address}${since}.', '', {name: providerLabel || L('its provider'), address: server?.mailUsername || account.emailAddress, since: signInState.signInText ? ' ' + ec.resource.expand('since ${date}', '', {date: signInState.signInText}) : ''}) : ec.resource.expand('Signs in with ${name}; it is not signed in now.', '', {name: providerLabel || L('its provider')})) : null signedIn = isOAuth && signInState.signedIn === true const everSignedIn = !!signInState.signInDate signInTitle = isOAuth && !everSignedIn ? L('Sign in') : L('Sign in again') oauthAgainText = isOAuth ? (oauthConfigured ? (everSignedIn ? ec.resource.expand('The sign-in with ${name} ended (a changed password, access taken back, or a long time unused), so mail is not syncing: sign in again.', '', {name: providerLabel}) : ec.resource.expand('This account signs in with ${name} and is not signed in yet: sign in to connect it.', '', {name: providerLabel})) : ec.resource.expand('This account signs in with ${name}, which is not set up on this server now: an administrator can set it up again. Or use a password or an app password:', '', {name: providerLabel || L('its provider')})) : null offerOAuth = canManage && account.hasServer && !isOAuth && oauthConfigured helpText = provider?.helpText || null helpUrl = provider?.helpUrl || null helpLinkText = provider?.helpLinkText || L('Where to make it') passwordTitle = provider?.appPassword ? L('App password') : L('Password') signIn = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId, emailAddress: account.emailAddress, mailPassword: ''} servers = server ? Object.assign({emailAccountId: emailAccountId, emailAddress: account.emailAddress, mailPassword: '', smtpPassword: ''}, server) : {emailAccountId: emailAccountId, emailAddress: account.emailAddress, storeKind: 'imap', storeSecurity: 'ssl', storeHost: '', storePort: '', smtpHost: '', smtpPort: '', smtpSecurity: 'starttls', mailUsername: account.emailAddress, mailPassword: '', smtpUsername: '', smtpPassword: ''} // the outgoing server's own sign-in (a provider whose SMTP takes another user): tried before it is saved smtpCaption = server?.smtpUsername ? (server.hasSmtpPassword ? L('The outgoing server signs in as its own user, with the password saved for it: leave its password empty to keep it, or empty the user to sign it in as above.') : L('The outgoing server signs in as its own user: enter its password.')) : L('Only when your provider\'s outgoing server signs in as another user than the incoming one: its user name and password, tried before they are saved.') // an account that signs in with Microsoft and reads its mail over POP: the sign-in must allow POP too popSignInText = isOAuth && server?.storeKind === 'pop' ? ec.resource.expand('The mail is read over POP: the sign-in with ${name} must allow POP access too. If the sync says the sign-in was refused, sign in again.', '', {name: providerLabel || L('the provider')}) : null const saved = detail.options || {} options = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId, accountName: saved.accountName || account.emailAddress, syncWindowDays: saved.syncWindowDays ? saved.syncWindowDays : 'all', recordFilingEnumId: saved.recordFilingEnumId, accountKindEnumId: account.accountKindEnumId} // personal or shared (a hosted account keeps its own kind among them) kindOptions = [{key: 'EakExternal', text: L('Personal: my own address')}, {key: 'EakShared', text: L('Shared: a team address read by several people')}] if (account.accountKindEnumId === 'EakHosted') kindOptions.unshift({key: 'EakHosted', text: L('Hosted here')}) kindNote = account.isShared && memberRows.length ? L('To make it personal again, remove the people who share it first, so only one is left.') : null // the folders a manager maps: what each is used as, and whether the sync reads it folderUseOptions = [{key: 'EfkOther', text: L('A folder of its own')}, {key: 'EfkSent', text: L('Sent')}, {key: 'EfkDrafts', text: L('Drafts')}, {key: 'EfkArchive', text: L('Archive')}, {key: 'EfkJunk', text: L('Spam')}, {key: 'EfkTrash', text: L('Trash')}] addMember = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId, memberPermissionEnumId: 'EapSend'} importFolderOptions = folderRows.filter((folder) => !['Drafts', 'Trash', 'Spam'].includes(folder.kindLabel) || !folder.isSpecial) .map((folder) => ({key: folder.emailFolderId, text: folder.isSpecial ? folder.kindLabel : folder.folderName})) importForm = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId, emailFolderId: (folderRows.find((folder) => folder.kindLabel === L('Archive')) || folderRows[0] || {}).emailFolderId || ''} canImport = account.canSend === true && importFolderOptions.length > 0 statusChip = '<q-chip dense square class="m-tonal text-' + account.statusColor + '">' + (account.syncing ? '<q-spinner size="12px" class="q-mr-xs"></q-spinner>' : '') // the test of both servers, when asked for (after a save, or Test the connection) testRan = false testError = null testPassed = false testSteps = [] testAdvice = '' testFolderNotes = [] if (runTest === 'Y' && canManage && account.hasServer) { const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.test#MailAccount').parameter('emailAccountId', emailAccountId).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) { testError = ec.message.getErrorsString(); ec.message.clearErrors() } else { testRan = true testPassed = out?.success === true testSteps = Array.from(out?.stepList || []) testAdvice = out?.adviceText || '' if (testPassed) needsSignIn = false // where the account uses a folder otherwise than the server marks it testFolderNotes = Array.from(out?.folderList || []).filter((folder) => folder.chosenHere && folder.noteText).map((folder) => ({text: folder.noteText})) } }
